rows.title: CT poised to take another huge chunk out of pension debt
rows.standfirst: The payment into CT’s cash-starved funds will raise total supplemental payments into those funds to nearly $7.7 billion in only four years.

rows.title: United Way: A family of four needs $126,000 a year to survive in CT
rows.standfirst: A new report shows that basic needs for a family of four in Connecticut are about four times the federal poverty level of $30,000.

rows.title: CT businesses challenge Lamont to rein in overtime spending
rows.standfirst: The $305.4 million in overtime that departments spent last fiscal year is nearly 50% higher than the $204.4 million bill they ran up in 2017.

rows.title: CT to leave big transportation funds unspent
rows.standfirst: Connecticut has resisted the lure of matching federal funds, leaving hundreds of millions unspent in its transportation fund since 2021.
